newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Dec wheat drops sharply on deliveries, expiry.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Dec wheat drops sharply on deliveries, expiry.

text.p: CBOT December wheat futures fell sharply early on the posting Tuesday of 460,000 bushels for delivery on that contract, traders said.
The December was susceptible to volatile swings as that contract approached expiration, which will occur at 1201 CST/1801 GMT Thursday, they said.
At 0953 CST, wheat was 1/4 to 10-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with December down 10-1/4 at $4.03-1/2. March was down 2-1/2 at $3.93-1/2.
